_doc: Valuation manual region. Per ticker write only: archetype (business-model prototype; defaults in quant/valuation/archetypes.py ARCHETYPES) and rationale (why it belongs to that prototype). Add overrides only when a value is known to be better than the prototype default (key names in OVERRIDE_KEYS); news_overlay turns an authorized news item into numbers (date/source/driver/delta/note). Zero authorization effect: sizing, entry and exit code never read this file.

SYNTH_STOCK.rationale: Synthetic placeholder: replace with the user's own classification and reasoning.
